items.name: pnpm
items.description: Fast, disk space efficient package manager

readme.excerpt:
Fast. Up to 2x faster than the alternatives (see benchmark). Efficient. Files inside node modules are linked from a single content-addressable storage. Great for monorepos. Strict. A package can access only dependencies that are specified in its package.json . Deterministic. Has a lockfile called pnpm-lock.yaml . Works as a Node.js version manager. See pnpm runtime. Works everywhere. Supports Windows, Linux, and macOS. Battle-tested. Used in production by teams of all sizes since 2016. Experimental Rust port. Includes pacquet, an experimental port of the CLI written in Rust. See the full feature comparison with npm and Yarn.

pnpm uses a content-addressable filesystem to store all files from all module directories on a disk. When using npm, if you have 100 projects using lodash, you will have 100 copies of lodash on disk. With pnpm, lodash will be stored in a content-addressable storage, so:

1. If you depend on different versions of lodash, only the files that differ are added to the store. If lodash has 100 files, and a new version has a change only in one of those files, pnpm update will only add 1 new file to the storage. 1. All the files are saved in a single place on the disk. When packages are installed, their files are linked from that single place consuming no additional disk space. Linking is performed using either hard-links or reflinks (copy-on-write).

items.name: seaweedfs
items.description: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for object storage (S3), file systems, Iceberg table buckets, and Lance vector buckets, designed to handle billions of files with O(1) disk access and effortless horizontal scaling.

readme.excerpt:
SeaweedFS is a simple and highly scalable distributed file system. There are two objectives:

1. to store billions of files! 2. to serve the files fast!

One SeaweedFS cluster serves an S3 object store, a POSIX file system, a lakehouse with S3 Tables and a built-in Iceberg REST Catalog, and vector search with S3 Vector Buckets, all on shared storage. Each blob is one disk read away, capacity grows by starting another volume server, and cloud storage can be cached or tiered transparently. Blob reads and writes have O(1) complexity and can run at the full speed supported by the underlying hardware.

items.description: A C/C++, Objective-C and CUDA language server built on Clang: crash-isolated worker processes, C++20 modules and compilation contexts out of the box, plus a CLI to index, query and refactor whole projects.

readme.excerpt:
A C/C++ language server written in modern C++, and more than a language server. Like clangd and ccls it is built on LLVM/Clang, but it is redesigned from the ground up to solve the problems their architecture has left unsolved for years. See What is clice?

The story behind clice and how it was built: clice v1.0 Released: Welcome to Modern C++.

- Multi-process compilation — Compiles run in a pool of isolated worker processes, as in a modern browser. A compile that crashes or leaks on a corner case or on half-typed code costs one worker, not the server: navigation and highlighting keep working, and memory and compile priorities are managed across the pool.

items.name: rikkahub
items.description: RikkaHub is an Android APP that supports for multiple LLM providers.

readme.excerpt:
A native Android LLM chat client that supports switching between different providers for conversations 🤖💬

- 🎨 Material 3 Expressive design - 📦 Workspace: a proot-based Linux agent environment - 📱 Phone Use: let the AI operate your phone - 🎬 Media generation (image and video) - 🔄 Multiple AI Provider Support: custom API / URL / models (all OpenAI, Google, Anthropic compatible api) - 🖥️ Web access for multi-platform use - 🛠️ MCP and Skills support - 📝 Markdown Rendering (with code highlighting, Latex formulas, tables, Mermaid) - 🔍 Search capabilities (Exa, Tavily, Zhipu, LinkUp, Brave, Perplexity, etc.) - 🧩 Prompt variables (model name, time, etc.) - 🤳 QR code export and import for providers - 🤖 Agent customization - 🧠 File-based memory - 📝 AI Translation - 🌐 Custom HTTP request headers and request bodies - 💌 Silly Tavern character card import

- Kotlin (Development language) - Koin (Dependency Injection) - Jetpack Compose (UI framework) - DataStore (Preference data storage) - Room (Database) - Coil (Image loading) - Material 3 Expressive (UI design) - Navigation 3 (Navigation) - Okhttp (HTTP client) - kotlinx.serialization (JSON serialization)
